offering_description.value: Meritage Homes develops residential communities and builds new single-family homes and townhomes, primarily for first-time and first move-up buyers. It sells homes directly through its communities and provides title insurance and closing services through its title agency.

primary_products.value: new detached single-family homes; new townhomes

primary_services.value: title insurance agency services; real estate closing and settlement services

customer_segment.value: B2C: First-time and first move-up homebuyers

end_markets.value: new residential construction; home purchase and settlement

revenue_model.value: product sales: Purchases of newly built homes and their lots; service fees: Real estate closing and settlement services; commissions or management fees: Placement of title insurance policies through its title agency
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops lots and uses trade contractors to build homes for individual buyers; service provider: Uses property records and transaction documents to arrange title insurance and close home purchases

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected Western, Southern and Southeastern states, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Texas, Florida, Georgia and the Carolinas

specialization.value: related lines: Detached homes, townhomes, title insurance and home closing services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving homebuyers; own locations: Community sales offices and model homes; agents / brokers: Independent real estate agents representing homebuyers; online: Company website with community listings, available homes and tour scheduling
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local zoning, permitting and building codes govern construction, and state insurance regulators license title agency activities.
